enabled.description: Enable or disable the archvsync service. Set to false to pause mirroring without uninstalling.

mirror_root.description: Absolute path to the root directory where the Debian mirror will be stored. Ensure sufficient disk space (≥1TB recommended).

max_rsync_jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent rsync jobs. Higher values increase speed but use more CPU and network bandwidth.

max_bandwidth_per_job_kb.description: Per-job bandwidth limit in KB/s. Set to 0 for unlimited. Use e.g., 1024 for 1 MB/s per job.

architectures.description: List of CPU architectures to mirror. Common choices: amd64, i386, arm64, armhf. Add only what you need to save space.

distributions.description: List of Debian releases and suites to mirror (e.g., stable, testing, version codenames). Use 'stable' only if you want automatic updates.

components.description: Debian repository components to include. 'main' is free software only; add 'contrib' and 'non-free' for firmware and non-free drivers.

sync_sources.description: Whether to download source packages. Source mirrors require significantly more disk space and bandwidth.

sync_installer.description: Include installer images (e.g., netinst ISOs). Recommended for full public mirrors.

delete_missing.description: Delete files from the local mirror if they no longer exist upstream. Enable only for strict mirrors after initial sync.

upstreams.description: List of upstream mirrors to sync from. Prefer rsync over HTTP for efficiency. Add mirrors geographically close to you.

log_file.description: Optional path to log file (e.g., '/var/log/archvsync.log'). Leave blank to use syslog instead.

admin_email.description: Email address for status and error notifications (e.g., sync failures).

run_cron.description: Enable the background cron job to check for updates and run sync periodically.

cron_schedule.description: Cron schedule in standard cron format (5 fields: minute hour day month weekday). Default runs daily at 02:00.

lock_file.description: Path to lock file used to prevent multiple concurrent sync runs.

proxy.description: HTTP/FTP proxy URL for outbound connections (e.g., 'http://proxy.company.com:8080'). Leave blank if no proxy is needed.

rsync_extra_opts.description: Additional rsync options to include in sync commands. Customize for performance or debugging.

max_metadata_age_hours.description: Alert if metadata (e.g., Release files) are older than this many hours. Helps detect sync failures.

generate_metaindex.description: Generate Packages, Sources, and Release index files (required for apt clients to use the mirror).

post_sync_script.description: Path to an optional script that runs after each successful sync (e.g., to trigger CDN purge or send custom notifications).
